description: This file contains unit tests for the BestFitBalancer class, verifying resource distribution algorithms including various edge cases and invariance properties.

classes.name: BestFitBalancerTests
classes.description: Contains multiple test methods to verify the functionality and properties of the BestFitBalancer resource distribution algorithm.

methods.name: IdealCaseMoreResourcesThanBucketsTest
methods.description: Tests resource distribution when resources exceed buckets, ensuring balanced allocation.

methods.name: IdealCaseMoreResourcesThanBuckets2Test
methods.description: Another scenario with more resources than buckets to validate distribution.

methods.name: IdealCaseLessResourcesThanBucketsTest
methods.description: Tests scenario where resources are fewer than buckets.

methods.name: IdealCaseLessResourcesThanBuckets2Test
methods.description: Secondary test with fewer resources than buckets.

methods.name: IdealCaseResourcesMatchBucketsTest
methods.description: Test where resources and buckets are equal in number.

methods.name: IdealCaseResourcesDevisibleByBucketsTest
methods.description: Checks distribution when resources are evenly divisible by buckets.

methods.name: IdealCaseRangedTest
methods.description: Iterates over a range of resource and bucket counts to validate distribution.

methods.name: HalfBucketsActiveTest
methods.description: Tests distribution with only half of the buckets active.

methods.name: OrderIrrelevantTest
methods.description: Ensures that reversing resources and buckets does not change the distribution outcome.

methods.name: ValidateBalance
methods.description: Helper method to verify that the distribution balances are within expectations.
